items.title: B2Gold Reports Fire-Related Incident to the Crushing Circuit at the Goose Mine
items.summary: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, April 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- B2Gold Corp. (TSX: BTO, NYSE AMERICAN: BTG, NSX: B2G) (“B2Gold” or the “Company”) announced today that a fire occurred in certain areas of the crushing circuit at the Goose Mine in the evening on April 16, 2026. On-site emergency responders were deployed and immediately initiated response procedures, and the fire was fully extinguished. No injuries were reported, no medical treatment was required, and mining operations are continuing on plan. The Company has been in contact with the relevant regulatory authorities. The Company is investigating the cause of the fire, as well as assessing the damage and potential impact on the operation. The Company’s initial assessment indicates that the fire was localized to the secondary crusher screen and feed belt. Further updates will be provided as more information becomes available. About B2Gold Corp. B2Gold is a responsible international gold producer headquartered in Vancouver, Canada. Founded in 2007, today, B2Gold has operating gold mines in Canada, Mali, Namibia and the Philippines, and numerous development and exploration projects in various countries. ON BEHALF OF B2GOLD CORP.
